matches.description: Watch New York Cosmos vs Athletic Club Boise highlights and goals from USL Championship on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on July 25, 2026. The USL Championship brought an intense atmosphere to the pitch on July 25, 2026 , as New York Cosmos hosted Athletic Club Boise in a fixture filled with tactical discipline and high stakes. Both sides looked to establish dominance early in a match that promised plenty of action under the lights. Second Half Breakthrough After a tightly contested opening period where clear-cut chances were at a premium, the game exploded into life shortly after the interval. The deadlock was finally broken in the 54th minute when Athletic Club Boise were awarded a penalty. B. Bodily stepped up to the spot and clinicaly dispatched his effort to give the visitors a crucial lead, silencing the home crowd. Before the New York Cosmos could mount a serious response, they were hit with a second blow just six minutes later. In the 60th minute, J. Crull found the back of the net to double the advantage for Boise . This quick-fire double put the visitors in a commanding position, forcing the hosts to overhaul their tactical approach in search of a way back into the contest. Late Drama in Stoppage Time As the clock ticked toward the final whistle, the New York Cosmos threw everything forward, determined to salvage something from the encounter. Their persistence paid off deep into stoppage time when S. Guenzatti scored in the 95th minute. The late strike gave the home fans a glimmer of hope and set up a frantic final few seconds. However, time ultimately ran out for the New York side. The referee’s final whistle confirmed a hard-fought victory for Athletic Club Boise , whose clinical edge in the second half proved to be the difference. While the Cosmos showed great character to fight until the end, they were left to rue the mid-game lapse that allowed the visitors to take control.
